note.para: First Aid Kit Additional Equipment, as required by AMC1 CAT.IDE.A.220 First Aid Kit (FAK), may be partly or totally included in the FAK.

dispcond.title: Non-required sets of FAK Additional Equipment inoperative, incomplete, or missing

requirement.para: One or more sets of non-required FAK additional equipment may be Inoperative, incomplete, or missing.

dispcond.title: One set of required FAK Additional Equipment inoperative, incomplete, or missing

requirement.para: One set of required FAK additional equipment may be inoperative, incomplete, or missing for two consecutive calendar days.
